name: Testosterone, transdermal gel
description: Unesterified testosterone in a hydroalcoholic gel applied daily to the skin, approved for testosterone replacement in males with hypogonadism. Carries a boxed warning for secondary exposure of women and children by skin contact. A Schedule III controlled substance.

systems.note: Androgen replacement is the labelled indication.
Lean-mass accrual is an intended effect.
Erythrocytosis is labelled, though generally less marked than with depot esters.
Prostatic growth and rising PSA are labelled.

monitors.why: Labelled monitoring parameter; trough timing matters less than with depots.
Transdermal delivery has a distinct aromatisation profile from depot esters.
